# Tea & Food Journal

> A personal knowledge base for tea and food, built on real experience. Bilingual (中文/English) recipes with ingredients, steps, tips, flavor profiles, and video tutorials.

Base URL: https://tea-food-journal.vercel.app

## Site Structure

- `/` — Home with featured recipes and categories
- `/recipes/[slug]` — Recipe detail (zh + en versions, language switch available)
- `/journal/[slug]` — Practice journal entry
- `/knowledge/[slug]` — Educational article
- `/categories/[category]` — Content by category (tea, soup, dessert, staple, home-cooking)
- `/tags/[tag]` — Content by tag
- `/ingredients/[ingredient]` — Recipes using an ingredient
- `/equipment/[equipment]` — Recipes using equipment
- `/search` — Full-text search
- `/rss.xml` — RSS feed
- `/sitemap.xml` — Sitemap

## Content Types

1. Recipe — Core recipe with ingredients, steps, tips, flavor profile, optional video tutorial
2. Variation — Derived from a parent recipe with modifications
3. Journal — Practice log recording real cooking experiences
4. Knowledge — Educational articles about ingredients, techniques, culture

## Knowledge Graph

The site builds a knowledge graph at build time connecting ingredients, equipment, tags, categories, and recipe variations.

## Tech Stack

- Next.js App Router, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, MDX content with gray-matter, Static Site Generation, no database
